Just verify that the adapter’s current rating exceeds the strip’s draw: 0.4 A per meter × number of meters, plus maybe 20% headroom.

[User_Spark]: The only time I recommend an extra series resistor is when the supply sits significantly above 12 V or when you’re dealing with automotive-style surges. In that case a small resistor can provide a bit of buffer.
